missing_reproduction_inputs: relaxed lattice vectors and atomic coordinates used in the calculation
exact PAW dataset identifiers and VASP version/input files
plane-wave cutoff and electronic/ionic convergence thresholds
finite-displacement amplitudes and complete displacement metadata
second-order force constants or Phonopy FORCE_SETS/FORCE_CONSTANTS
third-order force constants or thirdorder.py outputs
ShengBTE CONTROL file and isotope/boundary-scattering settings
mode-resolved frequencies, eigenvectors, group velocities, and c_mu(T)
unit-cell volume tied to the published relaxed structure
numeric C_src(T)=sum_mu(c_mu) with convergence or uncertainty
machine-readable TTG simulation inputs and outputs

availability_contract.publisher_statement: The supporting data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
availability_contract.scope: official PMC OA record and PMC8755757.1 object prefix captured on 2026-08-11

acquisition_decision.preferred_route_a: request the published relaxed structure, force constants, ShengBTE control/scattering outputs, and mode-resolved heat-capacity data from the corresponding authors
acquisition_decision.permitted_route_b: build an independent open-source graphite phonon input package and label it independent reproduction rather than Ding source data
prohibited_routes: infer C_src from the Ding normalized TTG curve
use Georgia Tech EMS-5000 k/D/c_p as Ding natural-graphite mode heat capacity
invent force constants, uncertainty, or C_src rows

claim_boundary: This package establishes only that the captured official PMC OA distribution does not expose the numerical or first-principles payload needed to reproduce C_src(T). It does not prove that such data do not exist with the authors or elsewhere, and it does not close C_src, e0, alpha_Phi_K, or Topic 13.
